label: GO after a1-rare-unrewarded trial, early episode, larger when a1 was repeated
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * table(ep_dec, {0:1.6,1:1.7,2:1.2,3:0.6,4:0.2}) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 3) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, 4) * (ep_trial < 40) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (ep_trial < 40)
explanation: Fires only at GO, almost exclusively on trials whose previous trial was a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded, i.e. the model-based stay-with-a1 case (that single indicator gives dev R^2 0.16 beyond timing). Magnitude decays with episode time: strongest in trials ~3-29, weaker by 30-49, near zero later; very first trials (ep_trial<3) lower. It is lower when the a1 choice on the previous trial was itself a switch from a2 (trial before was a2), and modestly higher when the ideal-observer belief favours S1 (clipped positive log-odds). Activation is bimodal (~0 or ~0.4) within the a1 S2 u early cell and the observed cues tried (belief, belief_cover, trial-before state/reward) do not separate the modes; even the future upcoming choice did not help. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.46 with these 4 terms vs 0.16 for the indicator alone; exceeds the profile all ceiling (0.23) because of the episode-time x pattern interaction. No model outputs used, so nothing is lost relative to the earlier value/policy explanation as far as tested.
